mapper.select: SELECT command_id, case_id, order_id, user_id, idempotency_key, status, failure_reason FROM refund_command WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO refund_command (command_id, case_id, order_id, user_id, idempotency_key, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{caseId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_command SET status = 'SUCCESS', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE command_id = #{commandId}
UPDATE refund_command SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE command_id = #{commandId}
UPDATE refund_command SET status = 'PENDING', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'FAILED'
